paite: Hiaite pimang a om koltanna a kipan a paitou, bial a tate, Babulon lam a akumpipa Nebukad-nezzar in apimang, Jerusalem leh Judah a, michih ama khua chiat a hong kik nawnte ahi uh.
heading: Saltang Kik Nawnte Min Gelhkhiakna / (Neh 7.4-73)
english: Now these are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his city;

paite: Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah toh hong tonte, Israel mite lak a pasal phazah:
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
The children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.
The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy-two.
The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy-five.

paite: Pahath-moab suante, Jeshua leh Joab tate, sangnih zagiat leh sawm-le-nih.
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred twelve.
The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty-five.
The children of Zaccai, seven hundred sixty.
The children of Bani, six hundred forty-two.
The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-three.
The children of Azgad, one thousand two hundred twenty-two.
The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-six.
The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty-six.
The children of Adin, four hundred fifty-four.
The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.
The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty-three.
The children of Jorah, one hundred twelve.
The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty-three.
The children of Gibbar, ninety-five.
The children of Bethlehem, one hundred twenty-three.
The men of Netophah, fifty-six.
The men of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.
The children of Azmaveth, forty-two.

paite: Kiriath-arim, Kephirah leh Beeroth suante, zasagih sawmli-le-thum.
english: The children of Kiriath Arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty-three.

paite: Ramah leh Geba tate, zaguk sawmnih-le-khat.
english: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty-one.
The men of Michmas, one hundred twenty-two.

paite: Bethel leh Ai mite, zanih sawmnih-le-thum.
english: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty-three.
The children of Nebo, fifty-two.
The children of Magbish, one hundred fifty-six.

paite: Elam dang suante, sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
english: The children of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
The children of Harim, three hundred twenty.

paite: Lod, Hadid leh Ono tate, zasagih sawmnih-le-nga.
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty-five.
The children of Jericho, three hundred forty-five.
The children of Senaah, three thousand six hundred thirty.

paite: Siampute: Jedaiah suante, Jeshua inkote, zakua sawmsagih-le-thum.
english: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.
The children of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.
The children of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.
The children of Harim, one thousand seventeen.

paite: Levi mite: Jeshua leh Kadmiel suante, Hodaviah suante, sawmsagih-le-li.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

paite: Lasa mite: Asaph suante, zakhat sawmnih-le-giat.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Kongkhak ngak mite: Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita leh Shobai suante, avek un zakhat sawmthum-le-kua.
english: The children of the gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all one hundred thirty-nine.

paite: Nethinim mite: Ziha, Hasupha leh Tabbaoth suante;
english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,
the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,
the children of Hagab, the children of Shamlai, the children of Hanan,
the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,
the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
the children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephisim,
the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,
the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

paite: Solomon sikhate tate: Sotai, Hassopheret leh Peruda suante;
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda,
the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

paite: Shephatiah, Hattil, Zebaim mi Pokereth leh Ami suante.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Ami.

paite: Nethinim mite teng, Solomon sikhate tate, zathum sawmkua-le-nih.
english: All the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

paite: Huchi in hiaite Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan leh Immer a kipan a paitoute ahi uh: himahleh apipute inkote, asuan uh, Israel a kipan ahi uhia chih ataklang thei kei uh:
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses and their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

paite: Delaiah, Tobiah leh Nekoda suante, zaguk sawmnga-le-nih.
english: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.

paite: Huan siampute suante: Habaiah, Hakkoz leh Barzillai Gilead mi Barzillai tanute a kipan azi kitenpihpa suante, amau min zui a sak in a-om hi.
english: Of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, and the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

paite: Hiai khangthu sutna a sim mite lak a min gelhna azong ua, himahleh amu kei uh. Huaiziak in buah a sim in a-om ua siamputna a kipan dangkoih in a-om uhi.
english: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found; therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

paite: Huan Tirshatha in, siampu Urim leh Thummim toh ahong dinkhiak mateng, thil siangthoupente ne lou ding in amau ahilh hi.
english: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim.

paite: Omkhawm tengteng avek un singli sangnih zathum-le- sawmguk ahi.
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

paite: Apasal sikhate uleh anumei sikhate uh, sangsagih zathum sawmthum-le-sagihte sim louh in pasal lasami leh numei lasami sangnih anei uhi.
english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.

paite: Asakolte uh zasagih sawmthum- le-guk ahi ua; sakol neute, zanih sawmli-le-nga;
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

paite: Sangawngsaute, zali sawmthum- le-nga; sabiltung uh, sangguk zasagih-le-sawmnih.
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

paite: Huan Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn ahong tun un, apipute uh inkuan lak a alupente akhen in, TOUPA' inn alamna ding in ut thu a thillat alan uhi.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households, when they came to Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for God’s house to set it up in its place.

paite: Nasepna sumbawm ah ahihtheihdan un dangka-eng darik singguk-le-sangkhat, dangka paun sangnga leh siampute puansilh zakhat.
english: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.

paite: Huchi in siampute, Levi mite, mite lak a akhenkhat leh lasa mite, kongkhak ngak mite leh Nethinim mite, akhopite uah ateng ua, Israel mite akhopite uah ateng uhi.
english: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
